links.scope: Separate engineering pilot; not the 60000-accepted primary cohort or its percentiles.

question: Can the published native sampler and separate full-order journal replay complete ten accepted records in each of the six pinned fields through the existing EKS command bridge with complete failure custody?

claims.text: If admitted and completed, each field has ten accepted records whose full journal prefix and acceptance predicates pass the separate reader.
The pilot does not test a historical selection cause, a G/b mechanism, percentile precision, performance or a weakness.

arms.description: Existing sampler_resume --pilot, target ten accepted records per field, preserving every attempt.
Separate journal_check verify over every mapped attempt, including sampler early-abort rejections; no new draw or replacement nonce.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No timing or comparative statistical claim. The deterministic toy A/A and recovery byte identities are separate required qualification controls, not additional real-field draws.

positive.not_applicable_reason: This is an engineering collection/replay pilot, not a feature detector. Known correct toy journals must pass the separate prelaunch qualification suite.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Malformed, missing, corrupt and reordered journals must be refused in the separate prelaunch qualification suite; they are not sampled null curves.

factors.name: source
factors.value: Native source pinned by SOURCE.sha256; old sampler law and original cohort unchanged.
factors.how: Bind publication receipt, image digest, native binaries and source inventory before freeze.

factors.name: nonce_and_index
factors.value: One post-freeze nonce with field/index domain separation.
factors.how: Keep the original nonce and next-index law on every recovery; never skip a slow or failed index.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record node, pod, imageID, CPU, kernel, resources, interruption and original deadline. No speed metric.

factors.name: order
factors.value: Producer then full replay within each field; bounded waves after capacity admission.
factors.how: Replay consumes the producer's exact journals. No independent resampling arm.

factors.name: failures
factors.how: Retain every attempt, incomplete field, timeout, OOM, corruption and infrastructure failure; no automatic retry.

comparisons.threshold: All six fields complete exactly ten accepted rows and full replay succeeds on the same journal bytes before their original deadlines.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Replay requires the producer's immutable journal; counts, not execution time, are evaluated.

seed_derivation.note: After the committed freeze, draw one fresh 32-byte nonce. Preserve the October 29 SHA256 domain, nonce, uint16_be(field_bits), uint64_be(index) mapping and SHA1 curve expansion.

instance_sampling.rule: The six pinned fields and the original acceptance predicates; ten accepted rows per field, every attempted seed retained.

blinding.how: All 21 original labels and old results are already known. This pilot cannot serve as a blinded historical-cause test.

power.note: Ten accepted curves per field is an engineering pilot, not a powered distribution test. No p-value or percentile inference is licensed.

primary.name: Accepted records per field
primary.definition: Complete accepted journal rows retained before the original deadline; target ten. Incomplete fields stay incomplete.

primary.name: Full prefix replay outcome
primary.definition: Separate reader rederives seed, curve, full order and acceptance for all mapped attempts; success requires target completion.
primary.source: journal_check verify exit status and raw report

secondary.name: Retained seed attempts
secondary.definition: Every contiguous attempted index, including map rejects and early composite aborts; never a replacement for accepted count.

record: original deadline, resource limits, failures and cost receipts

placement.capacity_admission: Pending live NodePool, quota, existing node/job and default-vCPU accounting.

stopping_rules.rule: Stop a field at exactly ten accepted records; never count ten attempted seeds as completion.

Do not admit any spend while the owner dollar cap, shared charged/committed/reserved balance or original absolute deadline is unknown; charge builds, whole workers, idle/queue exposure, storage, transfer and status launchers.
The entire producer plus replay stays within the original per-field 3600-second deadline including provisioning; max one attempt and no automatic retry.
An image/source mismatch, missing journal, invalid replay or failed custody prevents completion. Preserve and export the failure rather than resample.

invalidation_rules: Unresolved image/source, checkpoint, admission or canonical-export binding prevents launch.
No production restore claim without a separate real interruption/restore receipt.

decision_rule.text: Only declare this pilot complete if all six producer/replay pairs reach the fixed target with exact custody and independent reader success. Otherwise report the exact partial or failed flow.
decision_rule.statistic: Six field-level completion and replay outcomes; no hypothesis-test statistic.

inadmissible: Treating this draft as a freeze or launch approval.
Replacing the 60000-accepted primary cohort or ten published percentiles with this pilot.
Historical selection, G/b causation, speed or weakness claims from these engineering counts.
Discarding failures or slow indices, rerunning with a new nonce, or weakening a required gate.
Executing frozen Python, uploading the denied older auxiliary archive, changing credentials, infrastructure or keyrings.

literature.claim: Preserve exact sampling, acceptance, six fields, known-label disclosure and the separate primary target.
Full replay recounts mapped rejects; native recovery alone is not durable Spot recovery.
Shared daily/monthly admission includes charged, committed, reserved and all ancillary spending.
ellsea(E,1) may abort with zero; full replay treats that as a disposition, never an order.

extensions.runtime_checkpoint_adapter: Not implemented/qualified in this change; fsync to emptyDir is insufficient.
extensions.canonical_export_adapter: Pending; preserve failure/unstarted flow without fabricated attempts.
extensions.qualification: Local static build and bounded development controls only. EKS image execution and real-field pilot remain unrun.
